hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: An integer is sortable if its decimal digits already appear in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Check whether sorting the digit string of n leaves the string unchanged.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sum all such sortable integers in the inclusive range [low, high].

hints.title: Complete Implementation
